name: Arcade
author: Christopher Garay
description: Your games in the Omarchy bar, each one showing the frame you paused on — plus a fullscreen cover-art grid for browsing the whole library.

barWidget.description: Resume a RetroArch save state from the bar, with the frame you paused on as the thumbnail. Right-click for the fullscreen library.

schema.label: Rescan interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the library is rebuilt in the background. Opening the panel always rescans, so this only affects the count shown in the bar.

schema.label: Maximum library rows
schema.description: Caps rendered rows. Search still looks through the whole library.

schema.label: Silence notifications while playing
schema.description: Enables do-not-disturb for the length of the game, then restores whatever it was before.

schema.label: Suppress idle while playing
schema.description: Keeps the screensaver and lock screen away during long cutscenes, then restores your idle setting.

schema.label: ROM folder
schema.description: Leave empty to use RetroArch's own browser directory (~/Games/roms on a stock Omarchy install).

schema.label: Watch the ROM folder for changes
schema.description: Notices ROMs added or removed, new save states, and playlist imports without waiting for the rescan interval. Costs a few milliseconds per check.

schema.label: Watch interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the ROM folder is checked for changes. This is the cheap check, not a full rescan.
